app.title: Rubik's Cube · byarcy
app.description: Interactive 3D Rubik's Cube: timed challenge and guided practice.
size.label: Change cube size
hint.drag: Drag a face to turn it · drag outside the cube to rotate it
view.aria: Straighten the cube; tap twice for the starting position
view.straight: Already straight · tap twice for the starting position
drawer.title: TURNS
drawer.sub: Based on how you see the cube now
challenge.idle: Tap SCRAMBLE to start a challenge.
challenge.ready: Ready. The clock starts with your first turn.
pick.title: PRACTICE
pick.sub: Choose how much help and which lesson
pick.lessons: Lessons · the picture shows the goal of each stage
stage.label: Stage {n} of {total} · {name}
lesson.cross.title: WHITE CROSS
lesson.cross.complete: White cross complete! Tap New exercise (the lit button under the cube) to repeat it, or move on to lesson 2 · Corners.
lesson.cross.free: Build the white cross with no help: the four white edges around the white center, each one on the face of its color.
lesson.corners.title: WHITE CORNERS
lesson.corners.complete: White layer complete! Tap New exercise (the lit button under the cube) to repeat it, or move on to lesson 3 · 2nd layer.
lesson.corners.free: Place the four white corners with no help. The bar at the top tells you when the layer is complete.
lesson.secondLayer.title: SECOND LAYER
lesson.secondLayer.complete: Second layer complete! Tap New exercise (the lit button under the cube) to repeat it, or move on to lesson 4 · Yellow cross.
lesson.secondLayer.free: Place the four middle edges with no help: each one between the two centers of its colors. The bar at the top tells you when the layer is complete.
lesson.yellowCross.title: YELLOW CROSS
lesson.yellowCross.complete: Yellow cross complete! Tap New exercise (the lit button under the cube) to repeat it, or move on to lesson 5 · Yellow edges.
lesson.yellowCross.free: Make the yellow cross with no help: the four yellow edges pointing up, in any place. The bar at the top tells you when it is done.
lesson.yellowEdges.title: YELLOW EDGES
lesson.yellowEdges.complete: Yellow edges complete! Tap New exercise (the lit button under the cube) to repeat it, or move on to lesson 6 · Yellow corners.
lesson.yellowEdges.free: Put each yellow edge over the center of its color, with no help. The bar at the top tells you when it is done.
lesson.yellowCornersPlace.title: YELLOW CORNERS
lesson.yellowCornersPlace.complete: Every yellow corner is in its place! Some may still be turned: that is the last lesson, 7 · Turn corners. Tap New exercise (the lit button under the cube) to practice this one again.
lesson.yellowCornersPlace.free: Put each yellow corner in its place (between the three centers of its colors) with no help; it may still be turned. The bar at the top tells you when it is done.
lesson.yellowCornersTurn.title: TURN THE YELLOW CORNERS
lesson.yellowCornersTurn.complete: Cube solved! You have done every stage of the method. Tap New exercise (the lit button under the cube) to practice this step again, or try the whole cube in Challenge.
lesson.yellowCornersTurn.free: Turn the four yellow corners with no help: always the same side facing you, the corner in the front-top-right spot, and only the top layer to change corners. The bar at the top tells you when the cube is solved.
lesson.solve.title: FULL SOLVE

lesson.solve.complete.one: Cube solved, with {n} hint! Next time try it with none, and then take it to Challenge.
lesson.solve.complete.other: Cube solved, with {n} hints! Next time try it with fewer, and then take it to Challenge.

lesson.solve.completeClean: Cube solved with no hints! You are ready for Challenge: the same, against the clock.
lesson.solve.free: A whole scrambled cube, solved with the seven stages of the method. The bar at the top shows where you are. If you get stuck, tap HINT.
lesson.repeat.title: REPEAT UNTIL IT COMES BACK
lesson.repeat.complete: It came back! {total} times {name} and the cube is solved again. Tap New exercise (the lit button under the cube) for another algorithm.
lesson.repeat.free: Do {name} from memory, {total} times in a row and without turning the cube: it comes back by itself.
lesson.recognize.title: RECOGNIZE THE CASE
lesson.recognize.complete: Well spotted! Tap New exercise (the lit button under the cube) for another case.
lesson.recognize.free: Look at the lit pieces and choose which case it is.
msg.broken: The white cross came apart. Tap undo until it's back.
msg.wrong: That turn wasn't it. Tap undo and we'll go on.
msg.brokenLayer: The white layer came apart. Tap undo until it's back.
msg.brokenSolved: The part you had already solved came apart. Tap undo until it's back.
msg.cross.take: {piece} is in the white layer but in the wrong place. A half turn of that face sends it down to the {layer} layer.
msg.cross.middle: {piece} is in the middle layer. Bring it to the {layer} layer in 3 turns: the last one puts back whatever the first one moved.
msg.cross.align: {piece} is lit up. Turn the {layer} layer until it sits on the face of the {face} center.
msg.cross.up: {piece} is already on the {face} center's face and white points {dir}. A half turn of that face puts it in place.
msg.cross.flipped: {piece} is on the {face} center's face but flipped: white points sideways. These 4 turns put it in the right way.
msg.corner.align: {piece} is lit up. Turn the {layer} layer until it sits in front of its slot, the one in the pink frame.
msg.corner.take: {piece} is in the white layer but in the wrong place. Take it out in 3 turns and then we place it.
msg.corner.out: {piece} is in front of its slot and white points {dir}. That's 7 turns: the first 4 flip it and the last 3 put it in.
msg.corner.in: {piece} is in front of its slot and white points {dir}. It goes in with 3 turns.
msg.second.take: {piece} is in the middle layer but in the wrong place or flipped. These 8 turns take it down to the {layer} layer.
msg.second.align: {piece} is lit up. Turn the {layer} layer until it sits under the {face} center, the one with its side color.
msg.second.right: {piece} is under the {face} center. It goes up to the right, into the slot in the pink frame: 8 turns.
msg.second.left: {piece} is under the {face} center. It goes up to the left, into the slot in the pink frame: 8 turns.
msg.ycross.dot: Yellow is on top now, as in the guide. No yellow edge points up yet, only the center. These 6 turns make an L of yellow.
msg.ycross.L: There is an L of yellow on top (lit). These 6 turns turn it into a line.
msg.ycross.line: There is a line of yellow on top (lit). These 6 turns complete the cross.
msg.yedges.align: Turn the {layer} layer until at least two yellow edges sit over the center of their color.
msg.yedges.swap: Two neighboring edges already sit over their centers (lit). These 7 turns swap the other two; then the top layer lines them up.
msg.yedges.opposite: The two edges that match are opposite each other (lit). Do these 7 turns once: then two neighbors will match.
msg.ycorners.none: No yellow corner is in its place yet. Do these 8 turns once: one corner will land in its place.
msg.ycorners.cycle: A yellow corner is already in its place (lit), maybe turned. These 8 turns move the other three around it; sometimes they are needed twice.
msg.yturn.twist: Last step! Keep the same side facing you the whole time. The lit corner, in the front-top-right spot, is turned the wrong way: do these 8 turns. The rest of the cube will look messed up — don't worry, it comes back at the end.
msg.yturn.keep: The lit corner isn't turned the right way yet: these 8 turns, once or twice. The mess below is normal; keep the same side facing you.
msg.yturn.half: Finish the 4 turns you started (the same ones again), so the rest of the cube can come back at the end.
msg.yturn.next: That corner is right. Without turning the cube, turn only the {layer} layer to bring a corner that isn't right yet to the lit spot.
msg.yturn.finish: Every yellow corner is right and the rest of the cube came back. One turn of the {layer} layer finishes it!
msg.hint.piece: Now: stage {n} · {name}. The lit pieces are the ones to look at.
msg.repeat.guided: Repetition {n} of {total} of {name}. Watch the cube come apart: after {total} repetitions it comes back by itself.
msg.repeat.alone: Repetition {n} of {total} of {name}, from memory this time.
msg.repeat.broken: That is not the algorithm anymore. Tap undo until it is back on track, or New exercise (the last button under the cube).
quiz.noTurns: Here you only look: rotate the whole cube to see it from every side.
quiz.q.cross: The lit white edge is on the face of its center. Where does its white sticker point?
quiz.q.corners: The lit white corner is in front of its slot (pink frame). Where does its white sticker point?
quiz.q.secondLayer: The lit edge is under the center of its side color. Which way does it go up?
quiz.q.yellowCross: Yellow is on top. What shape do the yellow stickers on top make?
quiz.q.yellowEdges: Compare the yellow edges on top with the centers of the sides. Which ones match?
quiz.q.yellowCornersPlace: Look at the yellow corners: is one of them in its place? (It may be turned: its three colors are those of the three faces around it.)
help.title: HELP
help.use.1: Drag a face of the cube to turn that layer.
help.use.2: Drag outside the cube to rotate the whole cube: side to side spins it on itself, up and down tilts it toward you or away. If you flick it, it keeps spinning a little and slows down by itself.
help.use.3: On a phone, use two fingers to rotate the whole cube; twisting your fingers turns it on the screen, like a knob, from any position.
help.use.4: The box in the corner shows the side you can't see.
help.use.5: Below the cube are the icons: undo (back arrow), turns (grid, opens the letters) and scramble (crossed arrows). If the cube is partly solved, scramble asks for confirmation and first solves it by itself so you can see it in order; tap it again to scramble. Press and hold an icon to see its name.
help.use.6: The cube icon, top left, straightens the cube without flipping it: it removes the tilt and brings it face on. Tap it twice in a row (or hold it) to return to the starting position: white on top and green in front.
help.use.7: The 3×3 button next to the title switches to the 2×2 cube and back. Each size keeps its own progress and best time.
help.use.8: Challenge: tap scramble. The clock starts with your first turn and stops when you solve it. The button next to the time pauses it.
help.use.9: Practice: the bar at the top shows which stage of the layer-by-layer method you have reached. Tap the lesson's name to choose another one; each picture shows the goal of that stage. Each lesson practices one stage: 1 · Cross, 2 · Corners and 3 · 2nd layer with white on top, and 4 · Yellow cross, 5 · Yellow edges, 6 · Yellow corners and 7 · Turn corners with yellow on top, as the guide does. Each exercise starts with the earlier stages already done. The app lights up the pieces to look at, frames the slot and draws an arrow on the face to turn. When you get it, switch to Piece only or No help (in the same list as the lessons). Under More practice: Full solve is a whole scramble where help only comes when you tap HINT (which piece, where it goes, the turns); Repeat does one algorithm again and again until the cube comes back by itself; and Recognize shows a case and you choose which one it is.
help.use.10: Your progress is saved in this browser.
not.intro: Each letter turns a face 90° clockwise, looking at it head-on. The drawings show it as the guides do: you look at the front face.
not.outro: The letters follow your view: U is always the face you see on top.
algs.intro: Every algorithm of the method, as the guide writes it. Hold the cube as each stage says: the letters only work from that side.
algs.holdYellow: Yellow on top (turn the cube over).
algs.crossUp.when: The white edge is in the bottom layer, under the center of its other color (in front), with its white sticker facing down. A half turn of the front puts it in place.
algs.crossFlipped.when: Same place, but its white sticker faces you. These turns flip it on the way up.
algs.crossMiddle.when: The white edge is in the middle layer, between the front and the right. These turns take it down to the bottom layer without breaking the cross; then it is one of the two cases above.
algs.cornerRight.when: The white corner is in the bottom layer, under its slot (front right), with its white sticker facing right.
algs.cornerFront.when: Same place, with its white sticker facing you.
algs.cornerOut.when: Same place, with its white sticker facing down. These seven turns turn it and put it in.
algs.secondRight: Edge goes up to the right
algs.secondRight.when: The edge is in the bottom layer, under the front center (its color matches it), and its other color is the one on the right. It goes up into the slot between the front and the right.
algs.secondLeft: Edge goes up to the left
algs.secondLeft.when: The edge is under the center of the right face (its color matches it), and its other color is the one in front. It goes up to its left, into the same slot between the front and the right.
algs.yellowCross.when: Look at the yellow shape on top. An L: hold it at the back and on the left. A line: hold it across, from left to right. Only the center: from any side. Each time the shape grows: center → L → line → cross.
algs.yellowEdges.when: Turn the top layer until two edges match the centers below them. If they are neighbors, hold them at the back and on the right: the algorithm and a last U fix the other two. If they are opposite, do it once from any side and two neighbors will match.
algs.yellowCorners.when: A corner is in place when its three colors are those of the three faces around it (it may be turned). Hold the one in place at the front right on top and do it once or twice. If none is in place, do it once from any side and look again.
algs.yellowTwist.when: Hold a corner that needs turning at the front right on top and do the four turns twice, as many times as needed, until its yellow faces up. Then turn only the top layer (U) to bring the next one there. Don't turn the whole cube: the rest looks messed up until the last corner, and then it comes back.
